text:
alex: quick sync note from today's arch huddle: we need a compact fast-fail fallback flow for canary/A-B that avoids flip-flop and keeps cost predictable.
tara: agree. default pattern: local fast-decider + control-plane hard caps.
nate: details: decider is tiny state machine per-tenant, uses sliding-window p95, queue-length, and recent-fallbacks. outputs: allow/hedge/fallback-to-id.
leila: signals list: last 30s p95, in-flight queue, kv-hit-rate, small-eval quality-flag, warmup-availability. + operator overrides.
alex: fallback ordering rules: prefer same-family lower-precision -> co-located sibling -> cached-last-good -> truncated-synthesis. avoid cross-family unless explicit opt-in.
tara: make fallback decisions idempotent: include monotonic fallback_version in routing headers so retries are stable.
nate: oscillation controls: stability-window (require condition for N seconds), cooldown per-tenant (e.g., 30s), and a leaky-bucket cap on fallbacks per minute.
leila: session affinity: preserve KV continuity by preferring nodes with the same shard. if not possible, return cached-last-good with header x-safepath-warning.
alex: compact policy surface per-route: budget_ms, fallbacks (ordered list), stability_s, cooldown_s, max_fallbacks_per_min. keep it tiny.
tara: runtime footprint: keep per-tenant state only for hot tenants in an LRU store. cold-tenants fallback to control-plane defaults. LRU size tunable.
nate: cache priming: async prefix-KV push to fallback node when warmup budget available; do not block main request unless route opts-in.
leila: telemetry must include reason codes: capacity, latency_spike, quality_regression, operator_override, probe_timeout. include tenant_id, route, model_version, fallback_id, token_delta_estimate.
alex: rollout plan: (1) observe-only canary in one region; (2) enable auto-fallback for an internal tenant 48-72h; (3) small external cohort. track fallback-rate, latency quantiles, token-cost delta, and quality regressions.
tara: ops playbook: page if fallback-rate >1.5% sustained for 15m OR >500 fallbacks in 10m OR quality_regressions >3 in 1h. auto-rollback toggle available.
nate: policy DSL constraints: only sliding-window metrics allowed as conditions; actions limited to route-to/fallback-order/hedge-percent/no-op. evaluation O(1) per request.
leila: tests: unit sim for non-oscillation, integration for affinity-preserving fallback, chaos test with region capacity drop. include hysteresis and eviction checks.
ops-bot: deploy queued: fastcanary-fallback-v1 -> canary start 2026-07-12T10:00:00Z :rocket:
alex: next steps: I'll author RFC with API samples, small sim harness, and playbook. include cost-accounting per-event (token deltas) for finance.
tara: add note about audit trail retention for enterprise tenants.
nate: lgtm
leila: +1
alex: closing thread ":thumbsup:"
